name: Plague Concocter Mortieu

abilities.name: Quick Shot
abilities.description: A basic ranged attack that deals minor physical damage.

abilities.name: Acid Spray
abilities.description: The boss fires poison arrows in a spray dealing moderate poison damage over time as indicated by a red cone.

abilities.name: Release Flame
abilities.description: The boss throws a fireball at a target location that spreads out in four directions once it lands dealing moderate flame damage.

abilities.name: Plague Well
abilities.description: The grates around the arena will randomly activate shooting balls of poison at all players dealing moderate poison damage over time (this shows up as Spewing Plague). If unblocked, a larger poison ball (Plague Eruption) will trigger dealing high poison damage to the group. The tank should stand on the grates when they activate as indicated by a green circle to block the balls for the group.

abilities.name: Decaying Infection
abilities.description: Decaying Infection lowers the healing you receive. Your screen will glow red to indicate this.

abilities.name: Wilting Infection
abilities.description: Wilting Infection increases the cost of your Magicka abilities. Your screen will glow blue to indicate this.

abilities.name: Degenerative Infection
abilities.description: Degenerative Infection increases the cost of your Stamina abilities. Your screen will glow green to indicate this.

abilities.name: Summon Creatures
abilities.description: After the disease is applied, imps, stranglers, and Online:beetles will appear to attack the party. Jorvuld will call out for specific creatures to be killed to make the cure, but all of them should be killed to make the fight simpler.

abilities.name: Taking Aim
abilities.description: The boss will attempt to snipe Jorvuld while he is preparing the antidote. Interrupt this attack to prevent the boss from stunning Jorvuld so you can cure yourself quicker.

abilities.name: Antidote [verification needed]
abilities.description: Jorvuld will throw the antidote on the ground when it is ready. Run over to the green circle to pick up the buff, which dispels the Blistering Plague and its effects. The boss will also get stunned at this point. In addition, players will gain large bonuses to damage done, ultimate generation, and resource recovery, so use this chance to deal massive damage to the boss.

abilities.name: Summon Mortieu's Guard
abilities.description: When he gets stunned, he will summon a guard to help him. The guard deals high damage with its shield bash and should be killed quickly to simplify the fight.

dialogue.speaker: Plague Concocter Mortieu
dialogue.line: So busy, so busy, and now I must entertain these guests?

dialogue.speaker: Plague Concocter Mortieu
dialogue.line: You've caused quite the ruckus, yes. Quite the stir. Nasty, nasty guests
dialogue.trigger: If you idle, he'll say one of the following

dialogue.speaker: Plague Concocter Mortieu
dialogue.line: We'll purge this world, make it clean! All shall be blessed … and perish!
dialogue.trigger: When he is engaged in combat

dialogue.speaker: Plague Concocter Mortieu
dialogue.line: Too quick! Lets slow you all down.

dialogue.speaker: Plague Concocter Mortieu
dialogue.line: Let's drain that pesky energy, shall we?

dialogue.speaker: Plague Concocter Mortieu
dialogue.line: My blessing will leave you weak!

dialogue.speaker: Plague Concocter Mortieu
dialogue.line: It spreads within you! Pulsing! Yes!

dialogue.speaker: Plague Concocter Mortieu
dialogue.line: Such robust guests. I'll put an end to that!

dialogue.speaker: Plague Concocter Mortieu
dialogue.line: Do you feel it oozing? Such loving sickness!

dialogue.speaker: Plague Concocter Mortieu
dialogue.line: Nasty, nasty! I'll drain that pesky magic!

dialogue.speaker: Plague Concocter Mortieu
dialogue.line: Do you feel it? Your magic draining! Failing!

dialogue.speaker: Plague Concocter Mortieu
dialogue.line: Nasty, nasty spells! Let's put a stop to that.

dialogue.speaker: Plague Concocter Mortieu
dialogue.line: Let's light things up a bit, shall we?

dialogue.speaker: Plague Concocter Mortieu
dialogue.line: Ah, nothing like the smell of charred flesh!

dialogue.speaker: Plague Concocter Mortieu
dialogue.line: I also bring the blessing of fire's end! Ha!

dialogue.speaker: Plague Concocter Mortieu
dialogue.line: Fools! Get in here and protect me!

dialogue.speaker: Plague Concocter Mortieu
dialogue.line: Where are my guards? Get in here!

dialogue.speaker: Plague Concocter Mortieu
dialogue.line: Are you fools going to watch me suffer? Come out!

dialogue.speaker: Plague Concocter Mortieu
dialogue.line: Guards! Our guests need some extra care.

dialogue.speaker: Plague Concocter Mortieu
dialogue.line: This will end your meddling, you nasty mage!
dialogue.trigger: Plague Concocter Mortieu will also yell at Jorvuld Davaux throughout the fight.

dialogue.speaker: Plague Concocter Mortieu
dialogue.line: Will you stop with those nasty antidotes?
dialogue.trigger: Plague Concocter Mortieu will also yell at Jorvuld Davaux throughout the fight.

dialogue.speaker: Plague Concocter Mortieu
dialogue.line: No, leave my guests be! They belong with us now!
dialogue.trigger: Plague Concocter Mortieu will also yell at Jorvuld Davaux throughout the fight.

dialogue.speaker: Plague Concocter Mortieu
dialogue.line: Stop fiddling with my ingredients! Nasty, nasty!
dialogue.trigger: Plague Concocter Mortieu will also yell at Jorvuld Davaux throughout the fight.

dialogue.speaker: Plague Concocter Mortieu
dialogue.line: Feel my blessing! Let it spread!

dialogue.speaker: Plague Concocter Mortieu
dialogue.line: A little poison, some fumes. The ideal mixture for death!

dialogue.speaker: Plague Concocter Mortieu
dialogue.line: Your bodies shall wither away. Beautiful, beautiful!

dialogue.speaker: Plague Concocter Mortieu
dialogue.line: It oozes and pulses along your skin. Can you feel it spreading?

dialogue.speaker: Plague Concocter Mortieu
dialogue.line: Nasty, nasty …. She'll kill you all. Zaan the Scalecaller … will ….

notes: His progress on his plague research is detailed in his journals, Volumes One, Two and Three.
Mortieu's mother was a Vaermina cultist and was disappointed in her son for worshiping Peryite. Mortieu for his part, resented her.
related_quests: Plans of Pestilence: Conquer Scalecaller Peak and stop a dangerous plague from spreading.
Pledge: Scalecaller Peak: Prove you are truly Undaunted by clearing Scalecaller Peak.
summary: Nathien Mortieu, also known as Plague Concocter Mortieu, is a Breton found in Scalecaller Peak. He was the leader of the Peryite Cult which created the plague within the caverns and woke up Zaan the Scalecaller, before she was given control. In combat, he is very proficient in unleashing his various afflictions to hinder his enemies.
